versions.name: Sand Hill Scout Reservation

features.note: Heated showers at the developed campsites.
Eleven of the thirteen campsites have restrooms; two are primitive.

versions.summary: Sprawling 1,300-acre Scout camp of the Greater Tampa Bay Area Council near Brooksville, offering archery, rifle and shotgun sports, canoeing, rappelling, and swimming, with a first-year Scout program.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a visitor 2026-08-13 (submission OQbpv2a); submitter requested credit but provided only an email, which is withheld. Prior coordinates placed the camp on Florida's east coast; it is on the west coast near Brooksville (11210 Cortez Blvd). Coordinates cleared pending re-geocoding from the recorded address.
Coordinate placed 2026-08-14 from the corrected address via OpenStreetMap (road-level, approximate); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. July normals still pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
